issuer: the Nebraska Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
note: The DMV's licence page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class O operator's licence valid for 5 years at $29.00 ($24.00 and a $5.00 security fee), and says it is issued under 18 to one who has held a Provisional Operator's Permit for at least 12 months; the permit is issued from 16, so a full licence is kept from 17 (the permit's age is from the graduated licensing overview, which wasn't quoted: worth checking). The state ID card page says a state ID for U.S. citizens is free; non-citizens pay $29.00 for 5 years, and the card is kept as 5 years at no fee, the citizen's case.
